name: Meitav Trade Investments Ltd
summary: Meitav Trade Investments Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, provides securities trading services in Israel and Internationally. It offers securities trading services for various financial instruments, including stocks, convertible securities, government and corporate bonds, exchange-traded funds, foreign exchange-traded certificates, and options and futures contracts. The company also provides online trading, securities custody, market making, foreign exchange conversion, options and futures trading, investment marketing, and brokerage services, as well as financial credit to finance the purchase of securities and financial assets.
